task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Qiskit program that transpiles a 6-qubit random circuit (depth 5) to the basis gates ['rz','sx','x','cx'] with a line coupling map at optimization levels 0-3, printing depth and CX count for each level. Your answer must be the complete working code only, runnable from top to bottom.
